name: Email Verification Send Flow Handler
summary: Provides the canonical application boundary for issuing an initial or replacement email-verification proof, or throttling resend while keeping delivery failure outside auth-state transition semantics.
notes: The latest durable verification proof CreatedUtc is the authoritative 60-second resend cooldown clock.
No previous proof produces Sent/code-sent; an elapsed previous proof produces Resent/code-resent; a recent previous proof produces Throttled/resend-throttled.
Delivery failures return a failed InvokeResult and are not treated as successful auth-state transitions.

sourceReferences.note: The presence and age of the latest durable verification proof deterministically distinguishes initial send, accepted resend, and throttled resend without adding client-supplied resend intent.
